sql: CREATE TABLE messages (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, friend_id TEXT NOT NULL, role TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'chat', content TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', proactive INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'completed', error_text TEXT, mood TEXT, segments_json TEXT, sources_json TEXT, tool_calls_json TEXT, voice_status TEXT, voice_error TEXT, read_at TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, deleted_at TEXT, origin_device_id TEXT NOT NULL, origin_product_id TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE message_assets (message_id TEXT NOT NULL, asset_id TEXT NOT NULL, role TEXT NOT NULL, position INTEGER NOT NULL, meta_json TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (message_id, role, position));
